name: KyberSwap
description: KyberSwap is the DEX aggregator and liquidity platform of Kyber Network. It routes swaps across many decentralized exchanges on more than a dozen EVM networks and adds limit orders and zap tools for opening and managing liquidity positions.
description_zh: KyberSwap 是 Kyber Network 的 DEX 聚合器和流动性平台。它在十多个 EVM 网络上的众多去中心化交易所之间路由兑换，并提供限价单以及用于建立和管理流动性仓位的 Zap 工具。

geo_site.method: Cloudflare edge: HTTP 403 'Access from your country is currently restricted in accordance with our Terms of Use', for the site and for the aggregator API the app quotes with (aggregator-api.kyberswap.com). The countries are those of the live probe (see the observations; 2026-10-12: BY, CU, IR, MM, RU, VE, VN).

geo_feature.scope: per-country token restriction, country taken from the browser timezone (the code calls it a 'UX deterrent')

screening.provider: own Blackjack service (blackjack.kyberswap.com/api/v1/check) before each signature

tos.restricted: IR, KP, MM, CU, VE, BY, RU, VN, VG, Crimea/Sevastopol, uncontrolled DPR/LPR/Kherson/Zaporizhzhia, FATF high-risk

notes: Blackjack is called from the frontend before each signature. The aggregator API is a separate service.
live: kyberswap.com (2026-10-12): VN (Mobifone, VNPT) -> HTTP 403 'country is currently restricted in accordance with our Terms of Use'; 19 other countries -> app served
Blackjack: sanctioned -> blacklisted:true (reason 2, since 2023-12); control -> blacklisted:false

api_probes.name: aggregator route
api_probes.note: The route quote the app requests for a swap (ETH -> USDC on Ethereum); Cloudflare refuses it by country with the same page as the site.

rules.match: restricted in accordance with our Terms
rules.note: Cloudflare: 'Access from your country is currently restricted in accordance with our Terms of Use'
